# tag: geo.flag-quiz
which country has a maple leaf on its flag | flag with a maple leaf | red and white flag with a leaf => Canada's flag has a red maple leaf on a white square between two red bands.
which flag has a dragon | what country has a dragon on its flag => Wales and Bhutan have dragons on their flags. Wales has a red dragon, and Bhutan has a white thunder dragon.
which flag is not a rectangle | which country has a triangle flag | flag that isnt rectangular => Nepal's flag is the only national flag that isn't a rectangle. It's made of two stacked triangles, often said to stand for the Himalayas or for Hinduism and Buddhism.
which countries have square flags | is the swiss flag a square => Switzerland and Vatican City are the only countries with square flags.
which flag has a tree on it | flag with a cedar tree => Lebanon's flag has a green cedar tree in the middle. Other flags with trees include Haiti, Belize and Equatorial Guinea.
which flag has an eagle eating a snake | flag with eagle and snake => Mexico's flag shows an eagle on a cactus eating a snake, from the Aztec legend of how Tenochtitlan (now Mexico City) was founded.
which flag has a gun on it | flag with an ak 47 => Mozambique's flag has an AK-47 rifle crossed with a hoe on top of an open book. It's the only national flag with a modern rifle.
which flags have a map on them | flag with the shape of the country => Cyprus and Kosovo have maps of their countries on their flags.
which flags have the union jack | flags with the british flag in the corner => Australia, New Zealand, Fiji and Tuvalu have the Union Jack in the corner of their flags, and so do several British territories.
which flag has a red circle | flag with a red dot => Japan's flag is a red circle on white, standing for the sun. Bangladesh's flag has a red circle on green.
which countries have a cross on their flag | flags with a nordic cross => Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Finland and Iceland all have flags with a Nordic cross, a cross shifted toward the side near the pole.
which flag has a star of david | blue and white flag with a star => Israel's flag has a blue Star of David between two blue stripes on white.
which flag has a building on it | flag with a temple => Cambodia's flag shows the temple of Angkor Wat. It's one of very few flags with a building.
which flags have a bird on them | animals on flags => Flags with birds include Mexico, Uganda (a crowned crane), Papua New Guinea (a bird of paradise), Dominica (a parrot), Kiribati (a frigatebird), Zambia (an eagle), Zimbabwe and Albania.
which flags have a sun on them | flag with a sun face => Argentina and Uruguay have a sun with a face, called the Sun of May. Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, the Philippines, Malawi and Namibia also have suns.
what is the oldest flag in the world | oldest national flag => Denmark's flag, the Dannebrog, is thought to be the oldest national flag still used. A legend says it fell from the sky during a battle in 1219.
which flag is different on each side | flag with two different sides => Paraguay's flag has different emblems on the front and back, which makes it the only national flag like that.
which flag has a wheel | flag with a blue wheel => India's flag has a blue wheel with 24 spokes, called the Ashoka Chakra, in the middle.
which flag has a yin yang | flag with red and blue circle => South Korea's flag has a red and blue circle called the taegeuk, like a yin yang, with four black trigrams around it.
which flag has a parrot | purple parrot on a flag => Dominica's flag has a sisserou parrot, the national bird.
which flag has a shield and spears | flag with a shield => Kenya's flag has a Maasai shield and two spears in the middle. Eswatini's flag has a shield and spears too.
which flag has a lion holding a sword | flag with a lion => Sri Lanka's flag has a golden lion holding a sword.
which flag has volcanoes | flag with a volcano => Nicaragua and El Salvador have volcanoes in the emblems on their flags.
which flags have writing on them | flag with words on it => Some flags have writing, like Saudi Arabia (the Islamic statement of faith), Brazil (Ordem e Progresso, meaning order and progress), Iraq and Iran.
which flag looks like the american flag | flags similar to the american flag => Liberia's and Malaysia's flags look a lot like the US flag, with red and white stripes and a blue corner.
which flags look the same | which two flags are almost identical => Chad and Romania have almost the same flag, with blue, yellow and red stripes. Indonesia and Monaco both have red over white, in slightly different shapes.
which flag has a dagger | flag with swords => Oman's flag has a curved dagger called a khanjar over two crossed swords. Saudi Arabia's flag has a sword.
which flag has a nutmeg | why is there a nutmeg on grenadas flag => Grenada's flag has a nutmeg on it, because Grenada is famous for growing them.
which flag was just one color | flag that was all green => Libya's flag from 1977 to 2011 was plain green, the only plain one-color national flag in modern times. Libya has a different flag now.
which flag has the most stars | flag with 50 stars => The United States flag has 50 stars, one for each state, the most of any national flag.
which flags have a crescent moon | flag with a moon and star => Many flags of mostly Muslim countries have a crescent moon, like Turkey, Pakistan, Algeria, Tunisia, Malaysia and Azerbaijan.
what is the study of flags called | what is vexillology => The study of flags is called vexillology.
which flags have the southern cross | flag with southern cross stars => Australia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, Samoa and Brazil have the stars of the Southern Cross on their flags.
which flags are red and white | countries with red and white flags | what flags only have red and white => Red and white flags include Canada, Japan, Switzerland, Denmark, Poland, Austria, Indonesia, Monaco, Peru, Singapore, Latvia and Tonga.
which flags are green white and red | why do italy and mexico have the same flag => Italy and Mexico both have green, white and red stripes going up and down, but Mexico has its eagle emblem in the middle.
which flag has a two headed eagle | flag with a double headed eagle => Albania's flag has a black double-headed eagle on red. Serbia and Montenegro have double-headed eagles in their emblems too.

what is the national animal of the united states | national bird of america | what animal represents us => The bald eagle is the national bird of the United States, and in 2016 the American bison became its national mammal.
